event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: USA 221225 was represented by Erika REINEKE.
The race committee was represented by Zlatko Jakelic (Course representative ILCA 6).
Eric Boweb (coach of USA 221225) attended the hearing as an observer.
Tobias Hinton (member of the RC) attended the hearing as an observer.
Eunjin Kim (member of the IJ) attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The 6th attempt to start race nr. 6 (F1) for ILCA 6 Women Gold Fleet was made under RRS 30.4.
The race committee displayed a General Recall immediately after the starting signal.
After some minutes, the race committee displayed the sail numbers to be scored BFD before the next warning signal for that race, USA 221225 was not in that list.

The race committee reviewed its own records and identified USA 221225’s hull in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal.
At 19:14, the race committee posted Notice 12 with an updated list of boats scored BFD including USA 221225.
conclusions: The race committee is entitled to correct scoring errors when it determines from its own records or observations that it has scored a boat incorrectly and also to make correct scores available to competitors as per RRS 90.3(c).
There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to USA 221225.
